name: inventory_middle_drag
about: A middle-button drag in survival with 4 stone on the cursor over two empty slots (pressed over slot 9, moved within it, then onto slot 10): 1.7.10 runs it as a drag (mode 5, stages 0/1/2) and splits the stack, 1.8.9 sends the middle-drag stages (8/9/10) and its prediction rejects the drag.
